title: Upstream crosslink request: effort/thinking-budget dispatch parameter on kickoff run/plan and swarm

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CONTRACT-NAMED UPSTREAM CAPABILITY REQUIREMENT (the effort dial). vsdd's dials discipline is fail-closed: model AND reasoning-effort are specified at every dispatch, never silently inherited — the composition function right-sizes both (model tier + effort as the dispatched agent's provisioning), and the efficiency engine judges over/under-provisioning from the record. kickoff exposes --model and --timeout but NO effort/thinking-budget parameter (verified on kickoff plan/launch --help, 0.9.0-beta.1+6b4f736f), so on the kickoff path the effort dial is neither settable nor recorded (transcript audit: effort present in runtime-harness Agent records, absent from kickoff records — dispatch manifest is the only reliable source). ASK: an effort/thinking-budget flag on kickoff run/plan and swarm, passed through to the launched Claude session. Sibling of #851; both gate the intended vsdd-rides-crosslink end state.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Rolled into the kickoff epic: https://github.com/magnificentlycursed/crosslink/issues/2 (tracks the full vsdd kickoff bundle with upstream dollspace-gay/crosslink links; check-off happens there as upstream fixes land).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLOSED (tracked upstream + registry-carried): the effort-dial ask is dollspace-gay/crosslink#61 (design cycle planned upstream, per operator); deviation-registry entry dial-less-crosslink-dispatch carries the retest predicate (#61 closed) and the swarm-entry binding carries the dial condition. The registry entry is the living record.
